statement: Every header assignment in this file is confidence contract, not silkscreen. The official pin-number silkscreen was not available. This file contains no BCM numbers, no Allwinner port.pin numbers, and no 40-pin indexes. Do not layout a harness from it. Directions are from the compute module toward the named device.

fields.name: Logical net name.
fields.bus: UART, I2C, GPIO, USB, HDMI, MIPI-DSI, MIPI-CSI, PCIE, FAN, RF, POWER, SD, STORAGE, BOOT, or none.
fields.direction: in, out, inout, power, passive, or nc, as seen from the compute module.
fields.notes: Constraints and open items. Not a pin number.

shared_module.role: Orange Pi Zero 3W. Both carriers inherit these. They are module connectors, not 40-pin assignments.

nets.name: USB_C_5V
nets.device: USB 2.0 Type-C power port on the module
nets.notes: Only legal boot source. 5 V / 3 A. No USB-PD voltage above 5 V. MagStack, Qi, and OTG VBUS are not OR-ed into this net.

nets.name: USB_C_OTG
nets.device: USB 3.1 Type-C OTG on the module
nets.notes: DisplayPort Alt Mode 1.4, 4K60 capable. ThoxClip gadget ACM + RNDIS uses this port toward a host phone when docked. DP Alt stays unused because ThoxOS 1.0.0 does not start a display server. Not the boot power input.

nets.name: HDMI_MINI
nets.notes: 4K60 capable, dual independent with DP Alt or MIPI-DSI. Display server is off in 1.0.0 (PowerVR compositor deadlock risk). Do not start X11 or Wayland to probe this port.

nets.name: MIPI_DSI
nets.notes: Optional panel on ThoxMini is not driven in 1.0.0. ThoxClip has no panel. Not a boot dependency.

nets.name: MIPI_CSI0
nets.notes: Unused by both SKUs in 1.0.0. The two CSI connectors are not individually numbered here; CSI0 is the first logical name only.

nets.name: MIPI_CSI1
nets.notes: Unused by both SKUs in 1.0.0. Second logical camera connector. Not a pin index.

nets.name: MODULE_FAN
nets.notes: This is the module 2-pin header, not a 40-pin PWM assignment. The name PWM_FAN is intentionally unused. Control method inside the module is not documented here. Populate before a sustained ThoxMini NPU run. Not a boot dependency. Not the ThoxClip power policy.

nets.name: PCIE_FPC
nets.device: PCIe Gen3 x1 FPC on the module
nets.notes: Connector exists. Unpopulated on both SKUs in 1.0.0. Do not route a device.

nets.name: IPEX_ANT
nets.notes: Press cites Cdtech 20800D8-00. Kernel driver name is UNKNOWN. Attach the pigtail before any radio test. ThoxMini routes the pigtail to the enclosure wall. ThoxClip uses this same radio as the clip link. This net is not the ESP32-C6 antenna.

nets.name: MODULE_UART_DEBUG
nets.notes: Console at 115200. 8N1 and no flow control are the working assumption until a vendor image banner says otherwise. TX and RX are not individually numbered. Do not copy another board's debug pinout into a harness.

nets.name: MODULE_BOOT
nets.notes: Pins not numbered. Not used as a carrier strap. Do not flash boot0 from this contact.

nets.name: MODULE_PWR_TP
nets.notes: Pins not numbered. This contract does not claim they are the USB-C 5 V net and does not allow them as a second power inlet.

nets.name: MODULE_SD
nets.notes: Boot media, up to 128 GB. Vendor partition layout is kept. Do not rewrite the partition table.

nets.name: MODULE_EMMC
nets.notes: Optional 8/16/32/64/128 GB. Default unstuffed. Not a 1.0.0 boot device. A public parameter page has printed 8/16/32 only; confirm the footprint before any stuff.

nets.name: MODULE_UFS
nets.notes: Optional 32/64/128. Default unstuffed. Not a 1.0.0 boot device.

thoxmini.header: Logical nets on the module 40-pin, plus one study net that must stay off the 5 V rail. No pin index.
intentionally_absent: GPIO_DOCK_DET is a ThoxClip net; Mini uses GPIO_MAG_PRESENT instead
PWM_FAN is not assigned; the fan is shared-module MODULE_FAN

nets.name: UART_ESP_TX
nets.notes: Module transmits to the ThoxRoute coprocessor. 3.3 V only. Baud is not frozen; do not copy the 115200 debug console onto this link. Land pattern depends on the ESP32-C6 module SKU, which is not frozen. Framing is a software contract outside this file.

nets.name: UART_ESP_RX
nets.notes: Module receives from the ThoxRoute coprocessor. 3.3 V only. No flow-control nets are assigned.

nets.name: GPIO_ESP_RST
nets.notes: Chip-side intent, not an Allwinner pin. Espressif EN is active-high: high runs, low holds the chip off, and the pin must not float. While the 40-pin GPIO is high-Z, a carrier pull-down must hold EN low so the coprocessor stays in reset until thoxos-carrier.service drives this net high. Resistor value is not frozen. Confirm EN on the chosen module before layout.

nets.name: GPIO_ESP_BOOT
nets.notes: Chip-side intent, not an Allwinner pin. On the ESP32-C6, GPIO9 defaults high and selects flash boot; low at EN release selects download. Product boot must not pull this strap low. The carrier must also not pull chip GPIO8 low (GPIO8 and GPIO9 must not be low together at reset). Bench download may drive this net low and then pulse GPIO_ESP_RST. Sampled when EN rises, so set the strap before releasing reset.

nets.name: I2C_MAG_SCL
nets.notes: Shared by 24C02 at 7-bit 0x50 and INA219 at 7-bit 0x40. Carrier provides pull-ups to 3.3 V. Value is not frozen (do not rely on an undocumented module pull-up). Bus rate is not frozen. The 3.3 V header pin index is not in this contract.

nets.name: I2C_MAG_SDA
nets.notes: 24C02 is 256 bytes. Do not treat it as a larger EEPROM. Address pins are strapped for 0x50 and 0x40. INA219 shunt value is not frozen. Neither device gates boot.

nets.name: GPIO_MAG_PRESENT
nets.notes: Active level is not frozen. Record it from the first marked prototype. Presence must not gate boot. This is not ThoxClip GPIO_DOCK_DET.

nets.name: QI_COIL_STUDY
nets.device: Qi coil, mechanical and power study
nets.notes: Not a boot source. Open circuit to USB_C_5V and to every PMIC output. Do not OR it into the module 5 V rail. Not a 40-pin assignment.

thoxclip.header: One logical net on the module 40-pin. No pin index.
intentionally_absent: hardware fuse or strap that offlines the Cortex-A76 cores
PWM_FAN; optional airflow uses shared-module MODULE_FAN only

nets.name: GPIO_DOCK_DET
nets.notes: Active level is not frozen. Sensor type (switch or hall) is not frozen. Undocked is a normal boot state. Must not gate boot. When docked, userspace may bind ACM + RNDIS on shared-module USB_C_OTG. The dock does not replace USB_C_5V as the boot supply. DP Alt on that OTG port stays unused.
